# apple_scm_git_references (Data Source)

Lists the branches and tags of a repository connected to Xcode Cloud, which `apple_start_ci_build_run` builds.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_scm_git_references" "branches" {
  repository_id = data.apple_ci_products.app.products[0].primary_repository_id
  kinds         = ["BRANCH"]
}

locals {
  main_branch_id = one([for r in data.apple_scm_git_references.branches.git_references : r.id if r.name == "main"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the repository; see `data.apple_scm_repositories`.

### Optional

- `kinds` (Set of String) Kinds of reference to list. Values: `BRANCH`, `TAG`.

### Read-Only

- `git_references` (Attributes List) The references. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--git_references))

<a id="nestedatt--git_references"></a>
### Nested Schema for `git_references`

Read-Only:

- `canonical_name` (String) Full name of the reference, e.g. `refs/heads/main`.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the git reference.
- `is_deleted` (Boolean) Whether the reference is deleted in the repository.
- `kind` (String) Kind of reference: `BRANCH` or `TAG`.
- `name` (String) Name of the branch or tag, e.g. `main`.
